macro_logical_segments.name: Documentation preparation
macro_logical_segments.segment_summary: This segment covers the preparation of the discharge documentation package.

parallel_flows_boundaries.path_summary: Administrative documentation preparation happens in parallel with clinical preparation.

macro_logical_segments.primary_process_object_state_at_start: The discharge case has entered documentation preparation.
macro_logical_segments.primary_process_object_state_at_end: The documentation package is prepared for readiness assessment.
macro_logical_segments.macro_transformation: The discharge case is transformed from needing documentation preparation into having a prepared documentation package.
macro_logical_segments.main_operational_purpose: Prepare the documentation package required for discharge readiness assessment.
macro_logical_segments.boundary_rationale: The segment starts when documentation preparation begins and ends when the package is ready for assessment.
